Title: Enchiladas Verdes with Chicken and Queso Fresco
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Green Tomatillo Sauce | 100 g | onion |  | 000111
- Green Tomatillo Sauce | 15 g | garlic |  | 000112
- Green Tomatillo Sauce | 40 g | chili peppers |  | 000097
- Green Tomatillo Sauce | 10 g | cilantro |  | 000245
- Green Tomatillo Sauce | 25 g | lime |  | 000131
- Green Tomatillo Sauce | 1 tsp | table salt |  | 000292
- Chicken Filling | 500 g | chicken breast |  | 000044
- Chicken Filling | 20 ml | olive oil |  | 000378
- Chicken Filling | 1 tsp | ground cumin |  | 000278
- Chicken Filling | 1 tsp | Chili Powder |  | 000653
- Chicken Filling | 1 tsp | Garlic Powder |  | 000643
- Chicken Filling | 1 tsp | Ground Onion |  | 000644
- Enchilada Assembly and Baking | 300 g | tortilla |  | 000339
- Enchilada Assembly and Baking | 120 g | feta |  | 000197
- Enchilada Assembly and Baking | 80 ml | sour cream |  | 000222
- Enchilada Assembly and Baking | 60 g | lettuce |  | 000079

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Green Tomatillo Sauce | Prep |  | Roughly chop the onion and peel the garlic cloves.
2. Chicken Filling | Prep |  | SAFETY: Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels and wash hands immediately after handling raw meat.
3. Enchilada Assembly and Baking | Prep |  | Preheat your oven to 180°C and lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
4. Green Tomatillo Sauce | Prep |  | Remove the stems and seeds from the chili peppers to manage heat levels.
5. Chicken Filling | Prep |  | Season the chicken thoroughly with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, and ground onion.
6. Enchilada Assembly and Baking | Prep |  | Flash-fry the tortillas in a dry pan for 15 seconds per side to make them pliable.
7. Green Tomatillo Sauce | Cook |  | In a pot of boiling water, simmer the onion, garlic, and chili peppers for 10 minutes until soft.
8. Chicken Filling | Cook |  | Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
9. Enchilada Assembly and Baking | Cook |  | Dip each tortilla into the green sauce, then fill with a generous amount of shredded chicken.
10. Green Tomatillo Sauce | Cook |  | Drain the vegetables and transfer them to a high-speed blender.
11. Chicken Filling | Cook |  | Sear the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 74°C.
12. Enchilada Assembly and Baking | Cook |  | Roll the tortillas tightly and place them seam-side down in the baking dish.
13. Green Tomatillo Sauce | Cook |  | Add the fresh cilantro, lime juice, and salt to the blender jar.
14. Chicken Filling | Cook |  | Remove the chicken from the heat and allow it to rest for 5 minutes.
15. Enchilada Assembly and Baking | Cook |  | Pour the remaining green sauce over the rolls and sprinkle with half of the crumbled feta.
16. Green Tomatillo Sauce | Cook |  | Pulse until the sauce is smooth and emulsified; if too thick, add 15ml of water.
17. Chicken Filling | Cook |  | Using two forks, shred the chicken into thin strips.
18. Enchilada Assembly and Baking | Cook |  | Bake for 15-20 minutes until the sauce is bubbling and the edges are slightly golden.
19. Green Tomatillo Sauce | Serve |  | Keep the sauce warm in a small saucepan over low heat until assembly.
20. Chicken Filling | Serve |  | Toss the shredded meat with 30ml of the green sauce to keep it moist.
21. Enchilada Assembly and Baking | Serve |  | Top with shredded lettuce, a drizzle of sour cream, and the remaining feta before serving hot.

steps.text: Preheat your oven to 180°C.
Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bring a large pot of water to the boil.
steps.done_when: The water is at a rolling boil

steps.text: Roughly chop {i1} and peel {i2}.
Remove the stems and seeds from {i3} to manage heat levels.
Simmer the onion, garlic and chili peppers in the boiling water for 10 minutes.
Drain the vegetables and transfer them to a high-speed blender.
Add {i4}, {i5} and {i6} to the blender jar. Pulse until the sauce is smooth and emulsified; if it is too thick, add 15 ml of water.
steps.done_when: Smooth and emulsified, with no visible chunks

steps.text: Keep the sauce warm in a small saucepan over low heat until assembly.
steps.done_when: Hot, with the occasional bubble at the edges

steps.text: SAFETY: Pat {i7} dry with paper towels and wash your hands immediately after handling raw meat.
Season the chicken thoroughly with {i9}, {i10}, {i11} and {i12}.
steps.done_when: The chicken is evenly coated in spices

steps.text: Heat {i8} in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side.
steps.done_when: Browned on both sides and the internal temperature reaches 74°C

steps.text: Remove the chicken from the heat and allow it to rest for 5 minutes.
Using two forks, shred the chicken into thin strips.
steps.done_when: The chicken is in thin strips

steps.text: Toss the shredded meat with 30 ml of the green sauce to keep it moist.
steps.done_when: The chicken is glossy and moist

steps.text: Flash-fry {i13} in a dry pan for 15 seconds per side to make them pliable.
steps.done_when: The tortillas are warm and pliable

steps.text: Dip each tortilla into the green sauce, then fill with a generous amount of the shredded chicken.
steps.done_when: Each tortilla is coated in sauce and filled with chicken

steps.text: Roll the tortillas tightly and place them seam-side down in the baking dish.
steps.done_when: The rolls sit snugly seam-side down

steps.text: Pour the remaining green sauce over the rolls and sprinkle with {i14}.
steps.done_when: The rolls are fully covered in sauce

steps.text: Bake for 15-20 minutes.
steps.done_when: The sauce is bubbling and the edges are slightly golden

steps.text: Top with {i17}, a drizzle of {i16} and {i15}, and serve hot.

recipe.chef_note: Pat the chicken dry before seasoning so it sears well, and keep the sauce warm so the tortillas stay pliable when you dip them.  ,
